note: Rival hotels in the city. The architecture document names these in section 13 as the short-term substitute for a social layer, because visiting real players needs a server the project deliberately has not built. They are generated, deterministic, and never described to the player as people — a fake leaderboard implying real rivals would be a lie the game tells to feel busier than it is. 4A: a visit now collects a MONEY BAG worth the star-tier value from decision 1a (400/415/430), replacing the flat 30 coins. 19 visits plus the daily home bonus = the original snapshot's 20 bags a day. The city holds 24 hotels so the nineteen-visit allowance is actually spendable.
note_reward: The tip-jar substitute, sized deliberately small. A whole day of visiting must be worth less than an hour of running a hotel, or visiting becomes the game. The original's tip jars became exactly that for some players.
